name: Craziness
overview: Scripture reveals that true order and purpose come from God, who created all things (Genesis 1:1), and that Jesus Christ is the exclusive way to the Father (John 14:6). The unity of believers, grounded in the relationship between the Father and the Son, serves as a testimony to the world (John 17:21), while steadfast devotion to apostolic teaching and fellowship sustains the church community (Acts 2:42). In contrast, the introduction of ungodly influences that distort God's grace and deny Christ leads to spiritual confusion and disorder (Jude 1:4), highlighting that what may appear as 'craziness' is often the result of departing from the truth of God’s Word.
